prompt.zh: 镜头急速推近主体，冲击力强，开场抓眼
prompt.en: camera crashes in fast on the subject, high impact, attention-grabbing opening

prompt.zh: 镜头缓慢平稳推近主体，逐渐聚焦细节
prompt.en: camera pushes in slowly and steadily, gradually focusing on details

prompt.zh: 镜头缓慢拉远，逐渐揭示完整场景与主体全貌
prompt.en: camera pulls back slowly, gradually revealing the full scene and subject

prompt.zh: 镜头推近的同时背景被拉远压缩，主体大小保持稳定，空间张力强烈
prompt.en: dolly zoom: camera moves in while the background compresses away, subject size stays constant, strong spatial tension

prompt.zh: 镜头围绕主体缓慢环绕半圈，高光沿表面流动，立体感强
prompt.en: camera orbits the subject in a slow half circle, highlights sweeping across its surface, strong dimensionality

prompt.zh: 镜头固定，商品如置于旋转展台上缓缓自转，光影随转动流过表面
prompt.en: camera stays locked while the product slowly rotates as if on a turntable, light gliding across its surface

prompt.zh: 镜头沿弧线绕主体环拍四分之一圈，背景视差自然流动
prompt.en: camera arcs a quarter circle around the subject with natural background parallax

prompt.zh: 镜头缓慢横移扫过画面，展示场景层次
prompt.en: camera tracks laterally across the scene, revealing its layers

prompt.zh: 镜头平稳跟随主体动作移动，保持主体居中
prompt.en: camera smoothly follows the subject's movement, keeping it centered

prompt.zh: 镜头快速甩动转向主体，动感强烈，节奏利落
prompt.en: camera whips around onto the subject, high-energy, snappy pacing

prompt.zh: 镜头从低处缓缓升起并微微俯视主体，场景逐渐展开
prompt.en: camera cranes up from low, tilting slightly down on the subject as the scene opens up

prompt.zh: 镜头从高处缓缓下降贴近主体，收束到特写
prompt.en: camera cranes down from above, closing in on the subject into a tight shot

prompt.zh: 镜头垂直俯拍主体，缓慢下降贴近，桌面构图干净
prompt.en: top-down overhead shot descending slowly toward the subject, clean tabletop composition

prompt.zh: 轻微手持晃动感，呼吸般的自然移动，真实 vlog 质感
prompt.en: subtle handheld sway, breathing-like natural movement, authentic vlog feel

prompt.zh: 第一人称视角向前走近主体，画面自然微晃，沉浸感强
prompt.en: first-person POV walking toward the subject, natural slight sway, immersive

prompt.zh: 微距特写沿商品表面缓慢滑移，材质细节纤毫毕现
prompt.en: macro close-up gliding slowly along the product surface, material details razor sharp

prompt.zh: 低角度仰拍主体，镜头缓慢推近，气势感十足
prompt.en: low-angle hero shot, camera pushing in slowly, commanding presence

prompt.zh: 镜头先缓慢推近主体，随后固定住画面稳定收尾
prompt.en: camera pushes in slowly at first, then settles into a stable held frame to close

prompt.zh: LOCKED-ON SHOT：镜头如刚性固定在主体上，主体在画面中位置锁定不动，背景随移动流动
prompt.en: LOCKED-ON SHOT: camera rigidly mounted to the subject, subject pinned in frame while the background streams past

prompt.zh: FPV 无人机视角向主体快速俯冲贴近，路径流畅带速度感
prompt.en: FPV drone dive swooping fast toward the subject, fluid path with real speed

prompt.zh: 手持镜头贴近人物缓慢环走半圈，带自然呼吸晃动，背景视差流动
prompt.en: handheld camera walks a slow half-circle close around the person, natural breathing sway, background parallax flowing

prompt.zh: 镜头位置保持不动，焦点从前景缓缓转移到主体，景深变化引导视线
prompt.en: camera holds position while focus racks from foreground to the subject, depth guiding the eye
